main_text.p: Aff. בִּשְׁבָטָיו In tribubus ejus, Psalm.105. v.37. Chald. לְמִנְיַן שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל Secundum numerum tribuum Israëlis, Esr.6.17.
שְׁבָט m. Schebhat, nomen Mensis undecimi, respondentis Januario nostro, Zach.1.7.
* שָׁבַךְ Quæ hinc esse possint, vide in סָבַךְ.
שְׁבִיל m. Semita, Via: Aff. וּשְׁבִילְךָ Et semita tua, Psal.77.20. ubi legendum juxta Masorethas, שְׁבִילְךָ: Plural. Constr. שְׁבִילֵי עוֹלָם Semitæ seculi, Jer.18.15.
שָׁבֵל masc. Idem: חִשְּׂפֵי שָׁבֵל Denuda (pedes) ad semitam, Jesa.47.2. Vide Jes.20.2.
שִׁבֹּלֶת f. Spica, Job.24.24. סִבֹּלֶת Idem, Judic.12.6. item, Fluxus, Fluentum, Psal.69.3.16. Plural. fœmin. sub terminatione masculina, שִׁבֳּלִים דַּקּוֹת Spicæ tenues, Genes.41.5.
שִׁבֳּלִים m. p. Baccæ: Constr. שִׁבְּלֵי הַזֵּיתִים Duæ baccæ olivarum, Zachar.4.12.

שִׁבְלוּל m. Limax, Psalm.58.9. In Cod. Talmud. Mohed Katon cap.1. fol.6. scribit Scholiastes ad locum Psalmi: שִׁבְלוּל est reptile, quod cùm egreditur è concha sua, saliva fluit ab ipso, donec planè liquescat & moriatur. Et in Cod. de Sabbatho, cap.8. fol.77.
שִׁבְיסִים m. p. Reticula, ornamenta muliebria capitis, juxta R.Salomonem, Jesa.3.18.
שֶׁבַע f. Septem, Septies: שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים Septem annos, Genes.5.v.7. שֶׁבַע Septies in die laudavi te, Psalm.119.v.164.

שִׁבְעָה m. Idem: Item Septimus, שִׁבְעָה פָרִים Septem juvencos, Num.23.29. שִׁבְעָה שִׁבְעָה Septem septem, i.e. septenæ, Gen.7.2. בְּשִׁבְעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם Septimodecimo die mensis, Gen.7.11. Semel cum Jepenthetico, שִׁבְעָנָה, Job.42.13 [?]. Constr.

page.notes: Hebrew vocalisation and some Hebrew headwords are read from a small scan and may be imperfect; marked [?] where doubtful. The reference "Job.42.13" and the headword of the entry beginning "שִׁבְיסִים" are uncertain. Long s has been written as plain s throughout. The Hebrew headword of the entry "שִׁבְלִית" is partly uncertain.
